lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਧਉਸਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa sabad beechaar kaal vidhausiaa ||
lines.translation: Reflecting on the True Word of the Shabad, death is overcome.

lines.gurmukhi: ਢਾਢੀ ਕਥੇ ਅਕਥੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhaadhee kathe akath sabad savaariaa ||
lines.translation: Speaking the Unspoken Speech of the Lord, one is adorned with the Word of His Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਹਿ ਰਾਸਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਮਿਲੇ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥੨੩॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gun gahi raas har jeeu mile piaariaa ||23||
lines.translation: Nanak holds tight to the Treasure of Virtue, and meets with the Dear, Beloved Lord. ||23||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਤਿਅਹੁ ਜੰਮੇ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਨਿ ਤ ਖਤਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: khatiahu ja(n)me khate karan ta khatiaa vich paahi ||
lines.translation: Born because of the karma of their past mistakes, they make more mistakes, and fall into mistakes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੇ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhote mool na utarahi je sau dhovan paahi ||
lines.translation: By washing, their pollution is not removed, even though they may wash hundreds of times.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੇ ਬਖਸੀਅਹਿ ਨਾਹਿ ਤ ਪਾਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bakhase bakhaseeahi naahi ta paahee paahi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if God forgives, they are forgiven; otherwise, they are kicked and beaten. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਬੋਲਣੁ ਝਖਣਾ ਦੁਖ ਛਡਿ ਮੰਗੀਅਹਿ ਸੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bolan jhakhanaa dukh chhad ma(n)geeahi sukh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is absurd to ask to be spared from pain by begging for comfort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਇ ਦਰਿ ਕਪੜੇ ਪਹਿਰਹਿ ਜਾਇ ਮਨੁਖ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh dukh dui dar kapaRe pahirahi jaai manukh ||
lines.translation: Pleasure and pain are the two garments given, to be worn in the Court of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਥੈ ਬੋਲਣਿ ਹਾਰੀਐ ਤਿਥੈ ਚੰਗੀ ਚੁਪ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jithai bolan haareeai tithai cha(n)gee chup ||2||
lines.translation: Where you are bound to lose by speaking, there, you ought to remain silent. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਦੇਖਿ ਅੰਦਰੁ ਭਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa dekh a(n)dar bhaaliaa ||
lines.translation: After looking around in the four directions, I looked within my own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਅਲਖਿ ਸਿਰਜਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai purakh alakh siraj nihaaliaa ||
lines.translation: There, I saw the True, Invisible Lord Creator.

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਝੜਿ ਭੁਲੇ ਰਾਹ ਗੁਰਿ ਵੇਖਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ujhaR bhule raah gur vekhaaliaa ||
lines.translation: I was wandering in the wilderness, but now the Guru has shown me the Way.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਚੇ ਵਾਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਸਮਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur sache vaahu sach samaaliaa ||
lines.translation: Hail to the True, True Guru, through whom we merge in the Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਇਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਘਰਾਹੁ ਦੀਵਾ ਬਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: paaiaa ratan gharaahu deevaa baaliaa ||
lines.translation: I have found the jewel within the home of my own self; the lamp within has been lit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਸਚ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachai sabad salaahi sukheee sach vaaliaa ||
lines.translation: Those who praise the True Word of the Shabad, abide in the peace of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਡਰਿਆ ਡਰੁ ਲਗਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਸਿ ਗਾਲਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nidariaa dar lag garab s gaaliaa ||
lines.translation: But those who do not have the Fear of God, are overtaken by fear. They are destroyed by their own pride.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਵਹੁ ਭੁਲਾ ਜਗੁ ਫਿਰੈ ਬੇਤਾਲਿਆ ॥੨੪॥
lines.transliteration: naavahu bhulaa jag phirai betaaliaa ||24||
lines.translation: Having forgotten the Name, the world is roaming around like a wild demon. ||24||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮੈ ਭੈ ਮਰੈ ਭੀ ਭਉ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai vich ja(n)mai bhai marai bhee bhau man mahi hoi ||
lines.translation: In fear we are born, and in fear we die. Fear is always present in the mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਸਹਿਲਾ ਆਇਆ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhai vich je marai sahilaa aaiaa soi ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if one dies in the fear of God, his coming into the world is blessed and approved. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੀਵੈ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਖੁਸੀਆ ਖੁਸੀ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhai vin jeevai bahut bahut khuseeaa khusee kamaai ||
lines.translation: Without the fear of God, you may live very, very long, and savor the most enjoyable pleasures.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਭੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਜੇ ਮਰੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak bhai vin je marai muhi kaalai uth jaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, if you die without the fear of God, you will arise and depart with a blackened face. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਰਧਾ ਪੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal ta saradhaa pooreeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, then your desires will be fulfilled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਕਬਹੂੰ ਝੂਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal na kabahoo(n) jhooreeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you will never grieve.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa dukh na jaaneeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you will know no pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa har ra(n)g maaneeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you will enjoy the Lord's Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡਰੁ ਕੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa jam kaa dar kehaa ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, then why should you fear death?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਦੇਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa sad hee sukh dehaa ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, the body is always at peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤਾ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal taa nav nidh paaeeai ||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, the nine treasures are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਤ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਈਐ ॥੨੫॥
lines.transliteration: satigur hoi daiaal ta sach samaaeeai ||25||
lines.translation: When the True Guru is merciful, you shall be absorbed in the True Lord. ||25||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇ ਪੀਅਹਿ ਮਲਵਾਣੀ ਜੂਠਾ ਮੰਗਿ ਮੰਗਿ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sir khohaai peeahi malavaanee joothaa ma(n)g ma(n)g khaahee ||
lines.translation: They pluck the hair out of their heads, and drink in filthy water; they beg endlessly and eat the garbage which others have thrown away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫੋਲਿ ਫਦੀਹਤਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਲੈਨਿ ਭੜਾਸਾ ਪਾਣੀ ਦੇਖਿ ਸਗਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: phol phadeehat muhi lain bhaRaasaa paanee dekh sagaahee ||
lines.translation: They spread manure, they suck in rotting smells, and they are afraid of clean water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭੇਡਾ ਵਾਗੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਖੋਹਾਇਨਿ ਭਰੀਅਨਿ ਹਥ ਸੁਆਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhedaa vaagee sir khohaain bhareean hath suaahee ||
lines.translation: Their hands are smeared with ashes, and the hair on their heads is plucked out-they are like sheep!

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਊ ਪੀਊ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਨਿ ਟਬਰ ਰੋਵਨਿ ਧਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaoo peeoo kirat gavaain tabar rovan dhaahee ||
lines.translation: They have renounced the lifestyle of their mothers and fathers, and their families and relatives cry out in distress.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਨਾ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਨ ਪਤਲਿ ਕਿਰਿਆ ਨ ਦੀਵਾ ਮੁਏ ਕਿਥਾਊ ਪਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: onaa pi(n)d na patal kiriaa na deevaa mue kithaaoo paahee ||
lines.translation: No one offers the rice dishes at their last rites, and no one lights the lamps for them. After their death, where will they be sent?

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਠਸਠਿ ਤੀਰਥ ਦੇਨਿ ਨ ਢੋਈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਅੰਨੁ ਨ ਖਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: athasath teerath den na dhoee brahaman a(n)n na khaahee ||
lines.translation: The sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage give them no place of protection, and no Brahmin will eat their food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਦਾ ਕੁਚੀਲ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਮਥੈ ਟਿਕੇ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: sadaa kucheel rahahi din raatee mathai tike naahee ||
lines.translation: They remain polluted forever, day and night; they do not apply the ceremonial tilak mark to their foreheads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੁੰਡੀ ਪਾਇ ਬਹਨਿ ਨਿਤਿ ਮਰਣੈ ਦੜਿ ਦੀਬਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhu(n)dee paai bahan nit maranai daR deebaan na jaahee ||
lines.translation: They sit together in silence, as if in mourning; they do not go to the Lord's Court.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਕੀ ਕਾਸੇ ਹਥੀ ਫੁੰਮਣ ਅਗੋ ਪਿਛੀ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakee kaase hathee phu(n)man ago pichhee jaahee ||
lines.translation: With their begging bowls hanging from their waists, and their fly-brushes in their hands, they walk along in single file.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੋਗੀ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਜੰਗਮ ਨਾ ਓਇ ਕਾਜੀ ਮੁੰਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa oi jogee naa oi ja(n)gam naa oi kaajee mu(n)laa ||
lines.translation: They are not Yogis, and they are not Jangams, followers of Shiva. They are not Qazis or Mullahs.
